messages:
incidents-bot: PAGE: Continuous batching perf cliff detected in us-west-2.

incidents-bot: Alert details: queue_depth > 5k; p95_token_latency > 20s; error_rate (5xx+429) spike. Auto-created thread for eng-oncall.

Asha: I got it. Jumping in. Looking at dashboards now :eyes:

Mike: Noticed a prefetch heuristic rollout ~65m ago to reduce cold-starts. Could be related.

Devon: Traces show lots of microbatches of size 1 and sustained KV eviction churn. KV cache size normalized but eviction rate spiked.

Elaine: Confirming heap of backpressure in continuous-batcher. Microbatch wait times are high -> bigger queueing.

Asha: Plan: 1) disable prefetch heuristic 2) reduce continuous.batch.max_wait_ms 3) quick throttle on low-priority routes. Rolling step 1 now.

Asha: Run:
```
curl -X POST "https://admin.internal/api/flags/prefetch_heuristic" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"enabled":false}'
```

ops-bot: Flag change accepted, applying to control plane. Pushing to canary pool (30% nodes).

Asha: Applying microbatch param change to canary: set continuous.batch.max_wait_ms=10 (was 50) and cb.jitter_smoothing=0.8

Devon: Suggest also temporarily limit max_inflight_requests_per_node to 250 to prevent queue growth.

ops-bot: Hotpatch deployed to canary. Metrics in ~30s.

Mike: Customer impact FYI: two Dedicated customers (cust-8423, cust-9012) reported 10-20s responses and retrying. Support paged.

Elaine: Log excerpt showing queue/backpressure:
```
[2026-03-15T03:40:12Z] node=us-west-2-a batcher=continuous queue_depth=5234 in_flight=328 microbatch_dist=[1:0.62,2:0.26,3+:0.12] kv_evictions=120/s
[2026-03-15T03:40:27Z] node=us-west-2-b batcher=continuous queue_depth=4891 in_flight=290 microbatch_dist=[1:0.58,2:0.28,3+:0.14] kv_evictions=104/s
```

Asha: Canary shows p95 latency dropping from 22s -> 6s after flag + param changes. Increasing rollout to 100%.

ops-bot: Rolling hotpatch to all nodes (100%). Estimated completion ~2m.

Deployer: Hotpatch completed across region.

Sagar: Any risk to in-flight seqs when changing max_wait_ms? We should drain gracefully.

Asha: We switched to conservative drain: mark nodes read-only for new long requests and let in-flight finish. No hard kills.

Devon: Also routing fallback enabled: routes with high latency are switching to smaller model variant to shed token cost.

Mike: Support confirmed reduced error counts from customers and lowering retry storms. Noted some 429s during the peak window.

oncall-bot: ACTIONS: disabled prefetch_heuristic, reduced max_wait_ms, increased jitter smoothing, limited inflight per node, enabled model-fallback routing. Monitors added: cont_batch.queue_depth, cont_batch.p95_latency, kv_eviction_rate, 5xx_rate. Owner: Asha. ETA for RCA: EOD.

Asha: I'm going to run a focused replay to reproduce and capture traces. Also will open an RFC for prefetch heuristic safety gates.

incidents-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: p95 latency back to normal (<=2s), queue_depth stable < 200, kv_evictions normalized. Marking mitigated and moving to postmortem.

Asha: Closing thread for handoff to postmortem. Thanks team :heart:
